provider: HKU School of Computing and Data Science BStat Syllabus 2025-26
note: The official syllabus applies to the four-year BStat curriculum for students admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter. It requires one of three Professional Cores, which are modelled as isolated Programme-local Majors: Statistics, Decision Analytics, and Risk Management. This supplement records every code and title explicitly listed in the BStat degree requirements: two named UG5 courses, each Professional Core's introductory and advanced disciplinary courses, all four introductory mathematics alternatives, every bounded advanced elective list, and the four shared Capstone options. The unnamed Chinese language enhancement course, the open Common Core and Digital Literacy pools, non-credit national-education requirements, and the 66-credit open elective component are not expanded into fabricated course records. No recommended Year or semester is assigned because the syllabus classifies courses by introductory or advanced level rather than a normative study year.

supplements.ruleSummary: 240 credits: 54 UG5 credits, 30 introductory core credits, 12 introductory elective credits from either List A or List B, 42 advanced core credits, at least 30 advanced elective credits with at least 6 from List C1 and at least 12 from List C2, at least 6 Capstone credits, and 66 open elective credits.
supplements.evidenceGap: Only CAES1001 and CAES9821 are named and coded within the 54-credit UG5 requirement. The Chinese language enhancement, Common Core, Digital Literacy, national-education and 66-credit open elective components do not have closed Programme-specific coded lists in the syllabus.
